tools.name: kixie_agent_status
tools.description: Check whether a Kixie agent is logged in (registered) and whether they are on a live call. An offline agent returns success false with registered 0; that is a valid answer, not an error. Kixie Agent Status API: GET /www/agent/status.

tools.name: kixie_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the event webhooks configured for this Kixie account (calls, SMS, dispositions, voicemail). Kixie webhook API: POST /app/v1/api/getWebhooks.

tools.name: kixie_make_call
tools.description: Start an outbound call. Kixie rings the agent first, then dials the target number once the agent answers. This places a real, billed call. Kixie Make a Call API: eventname call.

tools.name: kixie_send_sms
tools.description: Send one SMS from the agent's Kixie number to a phone number. The message is delivered and billed. Kixie Send SMS API: eventname sms.

tools.name: kixie_send_team_sms
tools.description: Send a first Team SMS to a customer from a Kixie team number. Needs the Team SMS id from the Kixie dashboard (Manage > Numbers) and the Team SMS API enabled by Kixie support. Kixie Team SMS API: eventname bizsms.

tools.name: kixie_send_to_queue
tools.description: Ring an agent, then dial a contact from a Kixie queue. Queue ids are in the Kixie dashboard (Manage > Inbound > Queues). Kixie Send to Queue API: eventname queue.

tools.name: kixie_remove_from_queue
tools.description: Remove one phone number from a Kixie queue. Kixie Remove From Queue API: eventname queue, action remove.

tools.name: kixie_flush_queue
tools.description: Remove ALL numbers from one Kixie queue for one user. This cannot be undone from this tool. Kixie Flush Queue API: POST /app/legacy/flushUserQueue, call flushUserQueue.

tools.name: kixie_add_to_powerlist
tools.description: Add a contact to a Kixie powerlist (a dialing list). duplicate_handling sets what happens when the number already exists; the Kixie example uses overwrite. Kixie Add to Powerlist API: eventname updatepowerlist.

tools.name: kixie_remove_from_powerlist
tools.description: Remove one or more phone numbers from one Kixie powerlist. Kixie Remove From Powerlist API: eventname removefrompowerlist.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kixie_list_webhooks · Private data: kixie_send_to_queue, kixie_add_to_powerlist · Public sink: kixie_list_webhooks, kixie_send_sms, kixie_send_team_sms, kixie_send_to_queue, kixie_flush_queue · Destructive: kixie_remove_from_queue, kixie_flush_queue, kixie_add_to_powerlist, kixie_remove_from_powerlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kixie_list_webhooks · Private data: kixie_send_to_queue, kixie_add_to_powerlist · Public sink: kixie_list_webhooks, kixie_send_sms, kixie_send_team_sms, kixie_send_to_queue, kixie_flush_queue · Destructive: kixie_remove_from_queue, kixie_flush_queue, kixie_add_to_powerlist, kixie_remove_from_powerlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
